name: Speed Car
description: Picture the team as a race car: the engine pushes you forward and the parachute slows you down. A quick and playful way to find what helps and what holds back.

columns.name: Engine
columns.prompt: What speeds us up and helps us go faster?

columns.name: Parachute
columns.prompt: What slows us down and holds us back?

mood.energized: Quick and playful, matches high energy.
mood.tired: Only two columns and a light picture.

goal.fun: A race-car picture makes it fun.
goal.reflect-project: Finds what helps or slows down the work.

checkInQuestion: How fast do you feel today: parked, city speed or full throttle?
facilitationTips: Draw a simple car with an engine and a parachute on the board.
Keep the writing short: three minutes per column is enough.
Pick the biggest parachute and decide how to cut it loose.
